detail.longDescription: Where else should this diff have gone? Five shapes from 90 daily code reviews Since May 7, an agent has read every commit pushed to our repositories over the previous days and written a report in French. After 90 reports, I read the notes as a set instead of one morning at a time. Very few are logic errors inside a diff. The diff is usually right. The defect sits somewhere the diff did not go. https:// dev.to/pierrelaurentmedori/whe re-else-should-this-diff-have-gone-five-shapes-from-90-daily-code-reviews-44jm # CodeReview # SoftwareEngineering # Productivity # AI
